description: This file defines a PHP trait named 'DB' within the namespace 'MPF\Core\DBTRAIT'. It provides static methods for establishing and initializing a PDO database connection to a MySQL database, with connection parameters sourced from environment variables. The trait manages a singleton pattern for the database connection and handles exceptions related to database connectivity.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a PDO connection to the database using environment variables; sets error handling and fetch mode.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database connection if it has not already been established.
